title: Supporting Check: Does the request-response client enforce count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS sidecars limit?

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Count enforcement confirmed. Total sidecar count validated against MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars before request.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Both outbound request (client) and inbound response are bounded by MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars.

title: Supporting Check: Does the beacon-node server limit DataColumnSidecarsByRange responses to MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars?

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Server response quota prevents resource exhaustion.

title: Falsification Test: Can a response exceed count * NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS sidecars?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Client-side: rpc_send_request.go validates response does not exceed MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars. Server-side: quota enforcement in dataColumnSidecarsByRangeRPCHandler. Both sides independently enforce the cap, preventing response inflation attacks.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No response inflation path. Dual enforcement (client + server) prevents excess.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Dual-sided enforcement: server caps responses, client validates received count.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: Is the data column sidecar inclusion proof verified against the beacon block body?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: VerifyDataColumnSidecarKZGInclusion (via RequireSidecarInclusionProven in verification/data_column.go) verifies the Merkle proof that the KZG commitment is included in the beacon block body's KzgCommitments field. The inclusion proof links the sidecar to a specific beacon block.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Inclusion proof verification confirmed as mandatory step before KZG proof check.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Inclusion proof is mandatory in GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Inclusion proof properly verified as part of three-layer validation.

title: Supporting Check: Does actor-p2p-peer relay only data column sidecars that pass all validity checks?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: P2P gossip acceptance requires passing all GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements: ValidFields, SidecarInclusionProven, SidecarKzgProofVerified, and ValidProposerSignature. Only sidecars passing all checks are stored and relayed via subscriber_data_column_sidecar.go's receiveDataColumnSidecar.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Only validated sidecars are relayed. No bypass path.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Relay requires full validation. Attacker cannot relay invalid sidecars.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: All validity checks required before relay. No bypass.

title: Supporting Check: Does actor-beacon-node reject sidecars with invalid KZG inclusion proof?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: RequireSidecarInclusionProven in GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements is a mandatory check. Invalid inclusion proofs cause rejection at the verifier level. The verifier returns error on inclusion proof failure, causing gossip validation to reject the sidecar.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Invalid inclusion proof causes rejection. No acceptance bypass.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Inclusion proof check is mandatory. Invalid proofs rejected.

title: Falsification Test: Can a sidecar with an invalid inclusion proof be accepted by the beacon node?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Falsification: Can RequireSidecarInclusionProven be bypassed? The check is listed in GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements and is evaluated by the verifier. No optional flag or early return bypasses this check. The requirement is always evaluated.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No bypass path found. Inclusion proof check is unconditional.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: RequireSidecarInclusionProven cannot be bypassed in gossip path.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Inclusion proof check cannot be bypassed. Falsification attempt fails.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: Is verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_inclusion_proof correctly implemented?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: VerifyDataColumnSidecarKZGInclusion verifies that the KZG commitment at position sidecar.Index in the beacon block's KzgCommitments matches the Merkle proof in the sidecar. This is a standard SSZ Merkle proof verification using the beacon block body root.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Inclusion proof correctly verifies commitment against beacon block body.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Inclusion proof implementation is standard SSZ Merkle verification.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: KZG inclusion proof implementation invariant holds.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: KZG inclusion proof correctly implemented via SSZ Merkle verification.

title: Supporting Check: Does actor-p2p-peer enforce KZG proof verification before accepting data column sidecar?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified in GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements calls validateWithKzgBatchVerifier which eventually calls ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch. This is the third layer of the three-layer validation. KZG proof verification is mandatory for gossip acceptance.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: KZG proof verification confirmed as mandatory before acceptance.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: KZG proof check is the final mandatory step in gossip validation.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: KZG proof verification mandatory before sidecar acceptance.

title: Supporting Check: Does actor-beacon-node reject sidecars with invalid KZG proof?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch returns false for invalid proofs. VerifyCellKZGProofBatch in kzg.go returns error on false result. Gossip validator propagates error, rejecting the sidecar.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Invalid KZG proof causes rejection via error propagation.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Invalid proof rejected at KZG verification layer.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Invalid KZG proof rejected. No bypass.

title: Falsification Test: Can a sidecar with tampered column data and invalid KZG proof be accepted?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Tampered column data with invalid proof: ckzg4844.VerifyCellKZGProofBatch will return false (proof does not match data). If attacker regenerates proof for tampered data, the new proof won't match the commitment in the beacon block, which was verified by RequireSidecarInclusionProven. Dual binding via inclusion proof + KZG proof prevents any consistent tampering.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No tampering bypass. Commitment binds to block; KZG proof binds to commitment+cell.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Dual binding prevents consistent tampering: inclusion proof binds commitment to block, KZG proof binds cell to commitment.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Tamper detection invariant holds via dual binding.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Tampered sidecars rejected by dual binding via inclusion proof and KZG proof.

title: Verify Pre-Condition Ordering: Does KZG proof verification occur after inclusion proof verification?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: GossipDataColumnSidecarRequirements ordering: RequireValidFields -> RequireSlotStarted -> RequireSlotNotTooEarly -> RequireBlockNotAlreadyKnown -> RequireSidecarParentSeen -> RequireSidecarParentValid -> RequireSidecarDescendsFromFinalized -> RequireSidecarInclusionProven -> RequireValidProposerSignature -> RequireSidecarKzgProofVerified. KZG verification (most expensive) occurs after inclusion proof (cheaper Merkle check).

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Correct ordering confirmed: inclusion proof before KZG proof verification.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: KZG verification correctly placed after cheaper inclusion proof check.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001/tb-002/tb-003: Does bytes_to_kzg_commitment in kzg.go validate point-at-infinity?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: ckzg4844 handles bytes_to_kzg_commitment conversion. The Ethereum KZG spec allows the point at infinity (all-zeros commitment) as a valid commitment for empty data. ckzg4844 correctly handles this case. Prysm does not add additional point-at-infinity checks because the spec does not require them.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Point-at-infinity handled correctly per spec by ckzg4844.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: ckzg4844 handles all valid commitment forms including point-at-infinity.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Point-at-infinity handling invariant holds per spec.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Point-at-infinity correctly handled by ckzg4844 per Ethereum KZG spec.

title: Supporting Check: Is range validation enforced when actor-blob-submitter sends blobs via engine_getBlobsV2?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: engine_getBlobsV2 (GetBlobsV2 in execution/engine_client.go) fetches blobs from the trusted local EL. Range validation (blob count, index bounds) is not performed by the CL since the EL is a trusted component. Blobs from EL are verified via KZG proofs before use. The blob_submitter (actor who submits txns with blobs to EL mempool) is out of Prysm's direct validation scope.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: EL is trusted component. KZG verification provides integrity. Range not directly validated at CL-EL boundary.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: EL-CL interface is trusted. KZG proofs validate blob integrity.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: EL trust boundary invariant holds. KZG provides integrity guarantee.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: EL is trusted component. KZG verification provides blob integrity guarantee.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Blob range validation invariant holds via gossip requirements.
